care-mane-brush.name: Mane & Tail Brush
care-mane-brush.description: A paddle brush (Mare Care). Stroke a pony's mane or tail until it sparkles; on desktop look at her mane or tail and hold the mouse button.

care-coat-brush.name: Coat Brush
care-coat-brush.description: A soft body brush (Mare Care). Stroke a pony's coat with it; on desktop look at her coat and hold the mouse button.

care-hoof-pick.name: Hoof Pick
care-hoof-pick.description: A farrier's hoof pick. Ask a pony to lift a hoof by aiming at her leg, then pick the stones and dirt out of it. (Mare Care)

care-nippers.name: Hoof Nippers
care-nippers.description: Trim an overgrown hoof wall on a lifted hoof. On a shod hoof they pull the shoe. (Mare Care)

care-rasp.name: Hoof Rasp
care-rasp.description: Levels a lifted hoof after trimming. (Mare Care)

care-hammer.name: Farrier's Hammer
care-hammer.description: Drives the nails that hold a horseshoe on, and resets loose shoes. (Mare Care)

care-hoof-oil.name: Hoof Oil
care-hoof-oil.description: Work it into a lifted hoof and it shines. (Mare Care)

care-shoe-steel.name: Steel Horseshoes
care-shoe-steel.description: A set of steel horseshoes. Fit one to a lifted, trimmed hoof, then nail it on with the farrier's hammer. (Mare Care)

care-shoe-silver.name: Silver Horseshoes
care-shoe-silver.description: A set of silver horseshoes. Fit one to a lifted, trimmed hoof, then nail it on with the farrier's hammer. (Mare Care)

care-shoe-gold.name: Gold Horseshoes
care-shoe-gold.description: A set of gold horseshoes. Fit one to a lifted, trimmed hoof, then nail it on with the farrier's hammer. (Mare Care)

care-shoe-rainbow.name: Rainbow Horseshoes
care-shoe-rainbow.description: A set of rainbow horseshoes. Fit one to a lifted, trimmed hoof, then nail it on with the farrier's hammer. (Mare Care)
